guidebook.role.description.wathe:civilia:
A mere bystander, with absolutely nothing to make a name for themself.

This is the base civilian role. They have no unique features.

Innocents can search the train for clues, in which obtaining enough clues will grant them an emergency revolver. Emergency revolvers do not drop on death. If they find a dropped revolver however, they can pick it up and have it dropped upon their untimely death.

Innocents who shoots another innocent will cause the shooter to die of guilt. Shooting Accomplices, Killers, or the Executioner's target do not cause the shooter to die.

They win with other civilians and vigilantes.
guidebook.role.description.wathe:vigilan:
Armed with a gun, even upon first boarding the train.

Their objective is dispatch passengers with malicious intentions on the %1$s.

This is the base vigilante role. They have no unique features. If the vigilante dies, then their revolver will drop for innocents to be able to pick up. Revolvers that drop off the train will never appear back on again.

Innocents who shoots another innocent will cause the shooter to die of guilt. Shooting Accomplices, Killers, or the Executioner's target do not cause the shooter to die.

They win with other civilians and vigilantes.
guidebook.role.description.wathe:killer:
An unstable passenger with the intent of ridding the train of everyone who isn't like them.

Their objective is to kill every non-killer player using the tools in their arsenal.

This is the base killer role. They have no unique features.

Killers can search the train for clues, in which obtaining enough clues will grant them money. Killers cannot pick up dropped revolvers.

They win with other killers and killer accomplices.
guidebook.role.description.starexpress:s:
A peaceful passenger blessed with otherworldly abilities created to aid them, yet cause them to stick out like a sore thumb.

This role is planned to be reworked. Check back after it is announced to see how they work!
guidebook.role.description.starexpress:m:
A killer who has access to duct tape, which can silence players on the train. Duct tape is invisible in the hands of a killer, and duct taped passengers are not notified that they are taped until much later.

Taped passengers cannot speak, and must have another passenger remove the tape to gain back their voice. Innocents who remove tape from others lose mood for doing so.

If the taped passenger's mood drops to 0, the passenger will die if the tape gets removed or are outside. They can also die if they stay outside for too long.
guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
Entering from a far-off kingdom, having expended their time as their king's servant. They now seek to play one final trick that will go down in history.

Accomplices do not have to be killed for an innocent win unless they have become another killer.

This role is planned to be reworked. Check back after it is announced to see how they work!

A vengeful accomplice who awaits for a specific passenger's demise.

Their objective is to get their target killed by non-killer means (Getting shot by another innocent or a non-killer assisted death).

The executioner can pick up a dropped gun and shoot their target directly. Shooting a non-target instead will kill the executioner.

If the target is shot by another innocent, the shooter does not die from guilt. If the target dies from killer means, then the executioner switches to another random target.

The executioner can use their ability to random change their target. Upon successfully get their target killed, they become another random killer. The target cannot be a vigilante or a killer.

Executioners can be seen by other killer roles as a cohort, but the Executioner cannot see who else is a killer. They can see their target at all times.

Accomplices do not have to be killed for an innocent win unless they have become another killer.

A killer who has mastered the art of imitation. They have the unique ability to disguise themselves to appear as any other living passenger on the %1$s.

If the passenger that they are disguised as dies in any way, their disguise will be removed, and their identity will be revealed.

A killer who has the ability to sneak around undetected- their ability allows them to turn invisible for 20 seconds on a 2 minute cooldown.

While their body is undetectable, anything they hold and particles from sprinting is still visible to the naked eye. You can also hear their footsteps as well.

Phantoms will often choose to break into rooms and wait inside them, ready for a victim they can kill while hidden out of sight.

A killer who may or may not have smuggled a modified portal gun onto the %1$s. They have the ability to swap any player with any other player, thus teleporting both players to the other's location.

This role is disabled due to it's overpowered nature in-game. In the event of this role ever being enabled, then inform an operator of it's existence so it can be disabled again.

An accomplice who hungers for bodies on the train.

The Vulture uses their ability to consume bodies. Bodies that have been consumed will hide the time of death and role of the body.

Once they have "Consumed" enough bodies, they will become a random killer role.

When a Vulture consumes a body, they will have slowness with particles for a very short time, and a sound cue will play. Keep a keen ear, and be mindful of any light blue particles that emit from another passenger!

This accomplice cannot pick up a dropped revolver.

Vultures can be seen by other killer roles as a cohort, but the Vulture cannot see who else is a killer.

Accomplices do not have to be killed for an innocent win unless they have become another killer.
guidebook.role.title.noellesroles:the_in: The Insane Damned Paranoid Killer Of Doom Death Destruction And Waffles
guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
A killer who is able to hear dead people.

This is mostly a joke killer role, and is disabled. However, it may occasionally be enabled due to admin shenanigans, so be mindful when you get this role.
guidebook.role.title.noellesroles:conduc: It's not a Lockpick I Swear
guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
The driver of the %1$s, and has access to every room on the train.

The Conductor holds a Master Key, which grants access to every locked door on the %1$s. This item is dropped on death, which can be picked up by killers.

If there are less than 10 passengers aboard the %1$s, the Conductor's Master Keys will appear as Lockpicks.

They have been studying the art of drinks for a long time. They have a keen eye, and can see poisoned food/drink trays. Passengers who drink a beverage will also be glowed to the bartender for 8 seconds.

Is the defensive vial supposed to be 9999 coins? Yes. Please stop asking.

Laugh at this attention seeker!

The Noisemaker's body will glow upon meeting their demise. They also gain 50 coins per task completed and 5 coins at passive intervals, which can be used to purchase Firecrackers.

They can set a location by using their ability, then teleport back to that location by using their ability again.
Teleporting costs 100 coins, and the Recaller gains 50 coins per task completed.

Recallers are one of the only roles that can counter most, if not all, dangerous situations. This is, however, limited by their reaction time and if the guesser sees you teleport.

They can read dead bodies. They are able to see the time of death and role of a passenger body unless it has been eaten by the vulture, in which the information will be scrambled on the corpse.

They are the only innocent role that can confirm the presence of a vulture without directly seeing or hearing them eat a corpse.

Your in-game height is set to reflect your real-life height.

Yeah, you're short now. Deal with it.

They are somehow part Chameleon.

Standing still will slowly cause you to blend into your surroundings. Moving or being collided with causes you to appear visible again.
guidebook.role.title.noellesroles:guesse: Hey Guys my Role is Death By Voodoo Magic
guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
This killer has the ability to guess the role of any non-killer player. If they guess correctly, the victim dies immediately. If they guess wrong, the guesser dies.

This modifier can only be assigned to killers.

This killer has learnt from the Coroner, and has twisted their ability to assist their own murderous ideals.

The Graverobber can see information about dead bodies, much like the Coroner does.

This modifier can only be assigned to killers.
guidebook.role.title.noellesroles:feathe: Nuh uh Can't Body Block Me
guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
They have mastered the art of aerodynamics and staying out of the way of others.

The Feather cannot collide with other players, and falls slowly.
These unique abilities allow the Feather to fall off the side of the train and still have time to save themselves.
